def: to become sober again, i.e. (figuratively) regain (one's) senses

occurrences.text: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
